about_the_game:
Welcome to the Void.

You are a low-level contractor working for Void Tech, a mega-corporation specializing in satellite repairs and orbital maintenance. Your job? Fix what's broken, dodge space debris, and keep your oxygen levels in check—all while dealing with shady corporate policies and the occasional "classified" mission.

But something is off. As you take on routine contracts for NASAS, WESA, ISROR, and private companies like SpaceG, strange things start happening. Systems fail without explanation, encrypted messages appear in your mission logs, and your only lifeline—Mission Control—seems to be hiding something.

Do you follow orders blindly, or dig deeper to uncover the truth?

Key Features

🚀 Hardcore but Accessible Space Simulation – Manage oxygen, thrusters, and tools while floating in zero gravity. No hand-holding—just you, your EVA suit, and the cold void.

🛰️ Diverse Missions – Work with (or against) agencies like NASAS, WESA, and private space firms. Repair satellites, retrieve black-box data, and sometimes... cover things up.

💥 Physics-Based Hazards – Watch out for orbital debris, solar storms, and unpredictable equipment failures. A single mistake can send you spinning into the void.

🕵️ Uncover a Deep Sci-Fi Mystery – Strange transmissions, missing satellites, and encrypted files hint at something bigger than just broken tech. Will you find the truth or look the other way?

Void Tech isn’t just a job—it’s survival in orbit. Are you ready to float into the unknown?

name: Void Tech

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-760 (4*2800) or AMD Phenom II processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R7-260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

short_description: A story-driven sci-fi adventure where you repair satellites in Earth's orbit while unraveling corporate secrets. Navigate dangerous space debris, manage resources, and banter with mission control in a game packed with humor, mystery, and tough choices.
